knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The WA hairdressing guideline advises recommending a general practitioner visit. It allows the operator to continue only if they believe the service can be appropriately provided around the condition, so the recommendation is the first action.
The WA guideline does not require formal health screening. That position is confirmed for WA only.
A patch test record needs the product, site, time, result and client response to show what was checked and what happened.

practicalCriteria: Assessor observes the candidate run the full consultation questions in the approved order and record the answers on the job record
Assessor observes the candidate identify a simulated open wound or skin condition, stop the service, and write a referral or postponement record with the reason
Assessor checks a completed patch test record for the five required fields: product, site, time, result and client response
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Completed consultation form from a simulated client, with answers recorded
Referral or postponement record with the reason
Patch test record with the five required fields
stopWorkCriteria: A client presents with an open wound, infection or skin condition and the candidate proceeds with a chemical service
The candidate applies colour without completing the consultation
The candidate applies a product without a patch test where the product method requires one
